Adapted from David Joseph Wrisley's Assignment 2 F26 three-clickable-layer
Leaflet notebook, supplied in the course. One reviewed CSV replaces the three
geocoding-method files; its rows are split into educational-program layers.
No jitter is applied: co-location is evidence, and the popups retain source links.
Concentric marker sizes distinguish layers and do not encode enrollment.
The 41 unresolved records remain in the downloadable CSV and main reader's table.
Modern address/intersection references do not prove historical campus parcels.

Packages: leaflet, htmlwidgets, htmltools. Run from the folder containing the CSV.
The map was generated with R; dependencies are embedded afterwards by a local
packaging step because Pandoc is unavailable in this environment. Basemap tiles
still require an internet connection.

```{r}

library(leaflet)
library(htmlwidgets)
library(htmltools)
d <- read.csv("chicago-school-programs-1921.csv", stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
ok <- !is.na(d$latitude) & !is.na(d$longitude)
stopifnot(nrow(d) == 235, length(unique(d$institution_id)) == 200, sum(ok) == 194)
message(sum(ok), " mapped records; ", sum(!ok), " unmapped records retained in CSV")
map <- leaflet(options = leafletOptions(preferCanvas = TRUE)) |>
  addTiles(group = "Street") |>
  addProviderTiles(providers$Esri.WorldImagery, group = "Satellite") |>
  setView(lng = -87.668, lat = 41.86, zoom = 11)
groups <- c("Elementary", "Parochial high school", "Kindergarten")
colors <- c("#2275a5", "#bd5b12", "#7954a1")
radii <- c(9,6,3)
for (j in seq_along(groups)) {
  a <- d[ok & d$program == groups[j], ]
  a$popup <- paste0("<strong>", htmlEscape(a$institution_name), "</strong><br>",
    htmlEscape(a$program), "<br>", htmlEscape(a$address_transcribed),
    "<br>Reported enrollment: ", ifelse(is.na(a$students_total), "Not reported", a$students_total),
    "<br>Location evidence: ", htmlEscape(a$geocode_status),
    "<br>Modern reference only; historical parcel unverified.",
    "<br><a target='_blank' rel='noopener' href='", a$source_url,"'>Printed page ",a$page,"</a>")
  map <- map |> addCircleMarkers(data=a,lng=~longitude,lat=~latitude,group=groups[j],
     radius=radii[j],weight=2,color=colors[j],fillColor=colors[j],fillOpacity=.35,popup=~popup)
}
map <- map |>
 addLayersControl(baseGroups=c("Street","Satellite"),overlayGroups=groups,
   options=layersControlOptions(collapsed=FALSE)) |>
 addLegend(position="bottomright", colors=colors,labels=groups,title="Printed program",opacity=1) |>
 addScaleBar(position="bottomleft") |>
 addControl("<b>Chicago, 1921 directory</b><br>194 mapped program records; 41 unresolved.<br>Modern location references, not verified campus parcels.<br>Concentric sizes separate overlapping layers; sizes do not encode enrollment.",position="topright")
saveWidget(map,"notebook-map.html",selfcontained=FALSE,libdir="notebook-map-deps")

```
